sentences.text: Rule six is safe speed, and the first thing to know is that there’s no number in it.
Safe speed means you can take proper action to avoid a collision, and stop within a distance that fits the conditions.
Traffic density, including clusters of fishing boats.
Your own boat’s maneuverability: how fast she stops, how tightly she turns.
Try picking out a running light against the condo lights of Clearwater Beach.
The state of the wind, sea and current, and nearby hazards.
And your draft compared to the depth of the water.
Twenty knots might be perfectly safe in the open Gulf at noon, and reckless in the Intracoastal at dusk.
